facts.business: SMS Pharmaceuticals is engaged in the business of manufacturing Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), pharmaceutical intermediates and allied products, with a core domestic API segment driving approximately 96% of total sales and a diverse portfolio of over 55 products across 14 therapeutic categories.

capacity_or_capex.item: Advanced effluent treatment system (15 KLPD Stripper Column, 7 KLPD MEE, 3.2 KLPD ATFD)
Rooftop solar installation (1363 Kw DC / 1000 Kw AC)

guidance_or_targets.statement: Peptide pipeline projected to be fully operational
Rooftop solar to generate 15,00,000 Kwh/Annum from renewable energy

key_risks: Regulatory compliance risks across multiple international agencies (USFDA, PMDA, CDSCO, KFDA)
Environmental and pollution control risks requiring significant capex for ZLD, MEE, RO systems
Concentration risk with ~96% revenue from domestic API business
Dependence on key promoter directors (Chairman & MD aged 67, seeking re-appointment beyond 70 years)
No sustainable sourcing procedures in place
No product reclamation/recycling due to pharmaceutical regulatory framework
